def _parse_labels(raw: str | None) -> list[str]:
    if raw is None:
        return []
    try:
        v = json.loads(raw)
        if isinstance(v, list):
            return [str(x) for x in v]
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
        pass
    return []


def _serialize_labels(labels: list[str]) -> str:
    return json.dumps(labels)


def _parse_timestamp(raw: str | None) -> datetime:
    if raw is None:
        return datetime.now()
    # SQLite returns ISO-ish strings; try common formats
    for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"):
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(raw, fmt)
        except ValueError:
            continue
    # fallback: try fromisoformat (handles most ISO strings)
    return datetime.fromisoformat(raw.replace("Z", "+00:00").replace("+00:00", ""))

{"content":""""End-to-end tests for the tracker CLI via subprocess."""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

def _run(args: list[str], db_path: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    """Run `python3 -m tracker --db <path> <args...>` and return the result."""
    cmd = ["python3", "-m", "tracker", "--db", db_path] + args
    return subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)

def _parse_id(output: str) -> int:
    """Extract the numeric ID from output like 'issue 1: Title' or 'project 2: Name'."""
    m = re.search(r"\b(\d+):", output)
    assert m, f"Could not parse ID from: {output!r}"
    return int(m.group(1))

def test_project_add_and_list(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db = str(tmp_path / "test.db")
    r = _run(["project", "add", "Alpha"], db)
    assert r.returncode == 0
    assert "Alpha" in r.stdout
    r = _run(["project", "list"], db)
    assert r.returncode == 0
    assert "Alpha" in r.stdout

def test_issue_add_and_show(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db = str(tmp_path / "test.db")
    _run(["project", "add", "Beta"], db)
    r = _run(
        ["issue", "add", "Beta", "Fix login",
         "--desc", "Users can't log in",
         "--priority", "high",
         "--assignee", "alice",
         "--label", "bug"],
        db,
    )
    assert r.returncode == 0
    iid = _parse_id(r.stdout)
    r = _run(["issue", "show", str(iid)], db)
    assert r.returncode == 0
    out = r.stdout
    assert f"id: {iid}" in out
    assert "Fix login" in out
    assert "Users can't log in" in out
    assert "status: open" in out
    assert "priority: high" in out
    assert "assignee: alice" in out
    assert "bug" in out

def test_issue_set_status_priority_assignee_label_unlabel(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db = str(tmp_path / "test.db")
    _run(["project", "add", "Gamma"], db)
    r = _run(
        ["issue", "add", "Gamma", "Task",
         "--label", "a", "--label", "b"],
        db,
    )
    iid = _parse_id(r.stdout)

    # set status, priority, assignee
    r = _run(
        ["issue", "set", str(iid),
         "--status", "in-progress",
         "--priority", "critical",
         "--assignee", "bob"],
        db,
    )
    assert r.returncode == 0
    r = _run(["issue", "show", str(iid)], db)
    assert "status: in-progress" in r.stdout
    assert "priority: critical" in r.stdout
    assert "assignee: bob" in r.stdout

    # add label c, remove label a
    _run(["issue", "set", str(iid), "--label", "c"], db)
    _run(["issue", "set", str(iid), "--unlabel", "a"], db)
    r = _run(["issue", "show", str(iid)], db)
    assert "b" in r.stdout
    assert "c" in r.stdout
    # label a should be gone from the labels line
    labels_line = [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith("labels:")][0]
    assert "a" not in labels_line

def test_issue_close(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db = str(tmp_path / "test.db")
    _run(["project", "add", "Delta"], db)
    r = _run(["issue", "add", "Delta", "Close me"], db)
    iid = _parse_id(r.stdout)
    r = _run(["issue", "close", str(iid)], db)
    assert r.returncode == 0
    r = _run(["issue", "show", str(iid)], db)
    assert "status: done" in r.stdout

def test_issue_list_filters_and_sort(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db = str(tmp_path / "test.db")
    _run(["project", "add", "Eps"], db)
    _run(["issue", "add", "Eps", "Low1", "--priority", "low"], db)
    _run(["issue", "add", "Eps", "High1", "--priority", "high"], db)
    _run(["issue", "add", "Eps", "Med1", "--priority", "medium", "--assignee", "carol"], db)

    # filter by priority
    r = _run(["issue", "list", "--priority", "high"], db)
    assert r.returncode == 0
    assert "High1" in r.stdout
    assert "Low1" not in r.stdout

    # filter by assignee
    r = _run(["issue", "list", "--assignee", "carol"], db)
    assert r.returncode == 0
    assert "Med1" in r.stdout

def test_issue_search(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db = str(tmp_path / "test.db")
    _run(["project", "add", "Zeta"], db)
    _run(["issue", "add", "Zeta", "Search me", "--desc", "find this"], db)
    _run(["issue", "add", "Zeta", "Other thing"], db)

    # search by title
    r = _run(["issue", "search", "Search me"], db)
    assert r.returncode == 0
    assert "Search me" in r.stdout

    # search by description
    r = _run(["issue", "search", "find this"], db)
    assert r.returncode == 0
    assert "Search me" in r.stdout

    # non-matching search returns empty results (exit 0, no issues)
    r = _run(["issue", "search", "zzznope"], db)
    assert r.returncode == 0

def test_dependency_block_and_unblock(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db = str(tmp_path / "test.db")
    _run(["project", "add", "Eta"], db)
    r1 = _run(["issue", "add", "Eta", "A"], db)
    r2 = _run(["issue", "add", "Eta", "B"], db)
    id_a = _parse_id(r1.stdout)
    id_b = _parse_id(r2.stdout)

    # block A by B
    r = _run(["issue", "block", str(id_a), str(id_b)], db)
    assert r.returncode == 0
    r = _run(["issue", "show", str(id_a)], db)
    assert f"blocker: {id_b}" in r.stdout

    # unblock A by B
    r = _run(["issue", "unblock", str(id_a), str(id_b)], db)
    assert r.returncode == 0
    r = _run(["issue", "show", str(id_a)], db)
    assert f"blocker: {id_b}" not in r.stdout

def test_ready_issues(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db = str(tmp_path / "test.db")
    _run(["project", "add", "Theta"], db)
    r_a = _run(["issue", "add", "Theta", "A"], db)
    r_b = _run(["issue", "add", "Theta", "B"], db)
    r_c = _run(["issue", "add", "Theta", "C"], db)
    id_a = _parse_id(r_a.stdout)
    id_b = _parse_id(r_b.stdout)
    id_c = _parse_id(r_c.stdout)

    # close B (done)
    _run(["issue", "close", str(id_b)], db)

    # block C by A (open) and B (done)
    _run(["issue", "block", str(id_c), str(id_a), str(id_b)], db)

    # ready: only issues with all blockers done — C should NOT appear (A is open)
    r = _run(["ready"], db)
    assert r.returncode == 0
    # A has no blockers and is open, so it should appear in ready
    assert f"id: {id_a}" in r.stdout or "A" in r.stdout
    # C should NOT be ready because A is open
    assert f"id: {id_c}" not in r.stdout and "C" not in r.stdout

def test_blocked_issues(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db = str(tmp_path / "test.db")
    _run(["project", "add", "Iota"], db)
    r_a = _run(["issue", "add", "Iota", "A"], db)
    r_b = _run(["issue", "add", "Iota", "B"], db)
    r_c = _run(["issue", "add", "Iota", "C"], db)
    id_a = _parse_id(r_a.stdout)
    id_b = _parse_id(r_b.stdout)
    id_c = _parse_id(r_c.stdout)

    # close B (done)
    _run(["issue", "close", str(id_b)], db)

    # block C by A (open) and B (done)
    _run(["issue", "block", str(id_c), str(id_a), str(id_b)], db)

    r = _run(["blocked"], db)
    assert r.returncode == 0
    # C is blocked (A is open)
    assert f"id: {id_c}" in r.stdout or "C" in r.stdout
    # A is not blocked (no blockers)
    assert f"id: {id_a}" not in r.stdout and "A" not in r.stdout

def test_done_rejected_with_open_blocker(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db = str(tmp_path / "test.db")
    _run(["project", "add", "Kappa"], db)
    r_a = _run(["issue", "add", "Kappa", "A"], db)
    r_c = _run(["issue", "add", "Kappa", "C"], db)
    id_a = _parse_id(r_a.stdout)
    id_c = _parse_id(r_c.stdout)

    # block C by A (open)
    _run(["issue", "block", str(id_c), str(id_a)], db)

    # attempt to close C — should fail
    r = _run(["issue", "close", str(id_c)], db)
    assert r.returncode != 0

    db = str(tmp_path / "test.db")
    _run(["project", "add", "Lambda"], db)
    _run(["issue", "add", "Lambda", "O1"], db)

    assert r.returncode == 0

    # should have counts for open, in-progress, done
    assert "open" in out
    assert "in-progress" in out or "in_progress" in out
